## Project Overview
Building/maintaining a "Spice Route Exports" website — a multi-page static site with HTML (`index.html`) and a main stylesheet (`style.css`).

## Completed Work
1. Investigated mobile navbar layout issues — identified that the old `grid-template-columns: 40px 1fr 40px` approach caused the logo to appear off-center because the hamburger button's padding made it wider than the 40px column.
2. First fix attempt: switched `.nav-inner` to `display: flex; position: relative` with `.logo-link` using `position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%)` and `.hamburger` using `margin-left: auto`. Also updated `.nav-links-left` and `.nav-links-right` to use `width: 100%` and `order` properties instead of grid columns.
3. Added mobile-specific `.logo-img` override: `height: 44px; max-width: 110px`.
4. Discovered conflicting/duplicate CSS rules in the mobile section (two `.logo-link` blocks, a `.nav-inner > .logo-link { position: static }` overriding the hamburger's absolute positioning). Rewrote the entire mobile navbar section cleanly using `apply_diff`.

## Key Technical Decisions
- Desktop navbar uses `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr` with `height: 72px` — unchanged.
- Mobile navbar (≤768px) uses `display: flex; flex-direction: column; position: relative` on `.nav-inner`, with `.logo-link` taking `width: 100%; height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center` to visually center the logo, and `.hamburger` using `position: absolute; top: 0; right: 16px; height: 72px` to sit in the top-right corner without affecting logo centering.
- Mobile nav dropdowns (`.nav-links-left`, `.nav-links-right`) use `width: 100%` and stack below the logo row; toggled via `.open` class.
- Desktop logo: `height: 52px; max-width: 120px`. Mobile logo: `height: 44px; max-width: 110px`.

## Relevant Files & Code
- `style.css` — Main stylesheet. CSS custom properties defined in `:root`. Navbar styles at ~lines 206–281 (desktop). Mobile overrides inside `@media (max-width: 768px)` starting at ~line 1158. Mobile navbar section rewritten at ~lines 1163–1230.
- `index.html` — Main HTML file (open in editor, not directly modified in this session).

## Current Status
Most recently applied a clean rewrite of the mobile navbar CSS block via `apply_diff` to eliminate conflicting rules. The final mobile navbar approach:
- `.nav-inner`: `position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column`
- `.logo-link`: `height: 72px; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center`
- `.hamburger`: `position: absolute; top: 0; right: 16px; height: 72px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center`

The `apply_diff` was the last operation performed. Verification of the final saved state has not yet been confirmed.

## Pending Tasks
- Verify the final mobile navbar CSS saved correctly (read `style.css` lines ~1163–1230 to confirm clean output with no duplicates or conflicts).
- Test the mobile navbar visually in a browser to confirm the logo is truly centered and the hamburger sits correctly in the top-right.
